parameters.name: AcuType
parameters.description: ACU type

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description:
The number of RDS Custom instances that you want to create. The parameter is available if you want to create multiple RDS Custom instances at a time.

Valid values: **1** to **10**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: AutoPay
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic payment feature. Valid values:

*   **true** (default): enables the feature. Make sure that your account balance is sufficient.
*   **false**: disables the feature. An unpaid order is generated.

>  If your account balance is insufficient, you can set the AutoPay parameter to false. In this case, an unpaid order is generated. You can complete the payment in the Expenses and Costs console.

parameters.name: AutoRenew
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the instance. Valid values:

*   **true** (default)
*   **false**

parameters.name: AutoUseCoupon
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to automatically use a coupon. Valid values:
* **true** (default): Yes.
* **false**: No.

> If you use a coupon and later decrease the quota, the amount offset by the coupon will not be refunded.

parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

parameters.name: CreateAckEdgeParam
parameters.description: Information about the ACK Edge cluster.

parameters.name: CreateExtraParam
parameters.description: Reserved parameter. Not supported currently.

parameters.name: CreateMode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the instance can be added to an ACK cluster. When this parameter is set to **1**, the created instance can be added to an ACK cluster by invoking the **AttachRCInstances** API operation, enabling efficient management of container applications.

- **1**: Yes.
- **0** (default): No.

parameters.name: DataDisk
parameters.description: The information about the data disks.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description: The type of the data disk. Set the value to **cloud_essd**, which indicates Enterprise SSDs (ESSDs).

sub_parameters.name: DeleteWithInstance
sub_parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

sub_parameters.name: Device
sub_parameters.description:
The mount target of the data disk.

> This parameter is used only in the full image (entire machine image) scenario. You can set this parameter to the mount target of the data disk in the full image and modify the corresponding **DataDisk.Size** and **DataDisk.Category** parameters to change the disk category and size of the data disk in the full image.

sub_parameters.name: Encrypted
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to encrypt the cloud disk. Valid values:

*   **true**
*   **false** (default)

sub_parameters.name: PerformanceLevel
sub_parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

sub_parameters.name: Size
sub_parameters.description: The size of the data disk. Unit: GiB.

sub_parameters.name: SnapshotId
sub_parameters.description:
The snapshot used to create the data disk.

- If the snapshot size corresponding to **DataDisk.SnapshotId** is greater than the value of **DataDisk.Size**, the created disk size matches the snapshot size. If the snapshot size is smaller than the value of **DataDisk.Size**, the created disk size equals the value of **DataDisk.Size**.
- Creating an elastic ephemeral disk from a snapshot is not supported.
- Snapshots created on or before July 15, 2013 cannot be used to create disks.

parameters.name: DeletionProtection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable release protection. Valid values:  
* **true**: Enabled  
* **false** (default): Disabled

parameters.name: DeploymentSetId
parameters.description: The deployment set ID.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The instance description. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with http:// or https://.

parameters.name: DryRun
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

*   **true**: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, service limits, and insufficient inventory errors.
*   **false** (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, the instance is directly created.

parameters.name: HostName
parameters.description:
Hostname of the instance (2–64 characters).  

- Multiple segments separated by periods (.) are supported. Each segment can contain uppercase and lowercase English letters, digits, and hyphens (-).  
- A period (.) or hyphen (-) cannot appear at the beginning or end of a segment, nor can two periods or hyphens appear consecutively.

parameters.name: ImageId
parameters.description: The ID of the image used by the instance.

parameters.name: InstanceChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method of the instance. Set the value to **Prepaid**, which indicates the subscription billing method.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The instance name.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description: The instance type. For more information about the instance types that are supported by RDS Custom instances, see [Instance types for RDS Custom instances](~~2844823~~).

parameters.name: InternetChargeType
parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: InternetMaxBandwidthOut
parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: IoOptimized
parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: KeyPairName
parameters.description: The name of the AccessKey pair. You can specify only one name.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password of the account that is used to log on to the instance.

parameters.name: PasswordInherit
parameters.description: Specifies whether to use the password preset in the image. When this parameter is used, the Password parameter must be empty, and you must ensure that the selected image has a password already configured. Default value: false.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description: The subscription duration of the instance. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PeriodUnit
parameters.description:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

*   **Year**
*   **Month** (default)

parameters.name: PromotionCode
parameters.description: The coupon code.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID.

parameters.name: ScheduledRule
parameters.description: Scheduled elasticity rule

parameters.name: SecurityEnhancementStrategy
parameters.description: The reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the security group to which you want to add the new instance. Instances in the same security group can communicate with each other. The maximum number of instances allowed in a security group varies based on the type of the security group. For more information, see the "Security group limits" section in [Limits](~~25412~~).

>  The network type of the instance is determined by the security group specified by the SecurityGroupId parameter. For example, if the network type of the specified security group is VPC, the instance is a VPC-type instance. In this case, you must specify the VSwitchId parameter.

parameters.name: SpotStrategy
parameters.description:
The spot strategy for pay-as-you-go instances. This parameter takes effect only when the **InstanceChargeType** parameter is set to **PostPaid**. Valid values:  

- **NoSpot**: Normal pay-as-you-go instance.  
- **SpotAsPriceGo**: The system automatically bids based on the current market price.  

Default value: **NoSpot**.

parameters.name: SupportCase
parameters.description:
The deployment type of RDS Custom. Valid values:

- **eni**: Dual network interface cards.
- **edge**: Point of presence (POP) node pool.
- **share**: VPC.

parameters.name: SystemDisk
parameters.description: The specification of the system disk.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The list of tags.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The tag key. You can create up to N tag keys at the same time, where N ranges from **1 to 20**. Empty strings are not allowed.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value corresponding to the tag key. You can create up to N tag values at the same time, where N ranges from **1 to 20**. Empty strings are allowed.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description:
The instance user data. The raw data can be up to 32 KB in size.  

Do not pass sensitive information, such as passwords and private keys, in plaintext. If you must pass such information, encrypt it first, encode it in Base64, and then transmit it. Decrypt and use it inside the instance. The following is an example of converting a script into a Base64-encoded string:  

```
echo -n '#!/bin/sh
echo "Hello World"' | base64 -w 0
```

parameters.name: UserDataInBase64
parameters.description:
Specifies whether custom data is Base64-encoded.  

- **true**: Yes.  
- **false** (default): No.

parameters.name: VSwitchId
parameters.description:
The vSwitch ID of the instance. You must specify this parameter when you create an instance of the virtual private cloud (VPC) type. The specified vSwitch and security group must belong to the same VPC.

>  If you specify the VSwitchId parameter, the zone specified by the ZoneId parameter must be the same as the zone in which the specified vSwitch resides. You can leave the ZoneId parameter empty. In this case, the system uses the zone in which the specified vSwitch resides.

parameters.name: ZoneId
parameters.description:
The zone ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeZones operation to query the zone IDs.

>  If you specify the VSwitchId parameter, the zone specified by the ZoneId parameter must be the same as the zone in which the specified vSwitch resides. You can leave the ZoneId parameter empty. In this case, the system uses the zone in which the specified vSwitch resides.
